description: 🔎 Open source distributed and RESTful search engine.

latest_release.body:
## Version 3.10.1 Release Notes

Compatible with OpenSearch and OpenSearch Dashboards version 3.10.1

### Bug Fixes
* Fix scripted source reads failing on compound segments due to Java agent denying file open ([#23692](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/23692))

### Maintenance
* Update Reactor Netty to 1.3.9 and Project Reactor to 3.8.9 ([#23689](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/23689))
* Update bundled JDK to 25.0.5.1+2 for all distributions ([#23684](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/23684)), ([#23732](https://github.com/opensearch-project/OpenSearch/pull/23732))

hot_issues.title: [BUG] Upgraded indices aren't considered compatible for upgrade to 3.0.0
[RFC] Reader and Writer Separation in OpenSearch
[RFC] Pre Compute Aggregations with Star Tree index
[Concurrent Segment Search] support forceTermination for terminate_after parameter
[Proposal] Support server-side dual-write by mirror writes at coordinator node
[BUG] Vector searches frequently going into all shards unavailable with no indications of any cluster problems
